contexts.title: Chicago Fire (season 6)

contexts.text: On April 26, 2013, NBC renewed Chicago Fire for a second season[23] and moved its time slot to Tuesdays at 10:00 pm EST. The season debuted on September 24, 2013.[24]
contexts.title: Chicago Fire (season 2)

contexts.text: Jesse Lee Soffer revealed that there will be a lot more crossovers this season between Chicago P.D. and parent show Chicago Fire; "I think every episode from now on, they're going to have a couple characters from one show on the other" he told media sources.[28]
contexts.title: Chicago P.D. (season 2)

contexts.text: On May 10, 2017, NBC renewed the series for a sixth season, which premiered on September 28, 2017.[1][2]
contexts.title: Chicago Fire (TV series)
